info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Quartzite Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Quartzite Drill Detail Creation API allows users to establish detailed specifications for quartzite drill products in the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the addition of new drill details, including attributes such as size, type, and purpose, catering to manufacturers and suppliers in the drilling industry. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who require accurate and comprehensive data for effective inventory management and customer inquiries. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their product offerings and support customer needs efficiently.

post.summary: Create new details for a quartzite drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit new details regarding the quartzite drill. Ensure all required fields are included in the request body to successfully create the new details.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details associated with a quartzite drill. This payload should conform to the specified schema, which outlines the required fields and their types.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning drill details.

CreateCatalogQuartziteDrillDetailRequest.title: Quartzite Drill Request Body

quartzite_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the quartzite drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of quartzite drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of quartzite drill.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the quartzite drill request.

items.description: A tag for categorizing the quartzite drill request.

CreateCatalogQuartziteDrillDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for creating a quartzite drill operation.

CreateCatalogQuartziteDrillDetailRespons.title: Quartzite Drill Operation Response

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

warnings.description: A list of warnings generated during the processing.
example: Warning: record 5 did not meet criteria

CreateCatalogQuartziteDrillDetailRespons.description: Response object for operations performed by the Quartzite drill.

content-type.description: The media type of the returned content in the response. This should indicate the format of the data being sent, commonly application/json for JSON formatted responses.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value can help clients understand the performance implications of their request.
